trigger.description: Create a service that runs as a Microsoft Foundry hosted agent over the Invocations protocol.

metadata.label: Foundry Listener
metadata.description: Serves the Foundry Invocations protocol and the readiness probe over HTTP.

section.label: Foundry Listener
section.description: Attach the agent to a new or existing Foundry listener.

createNew.label: Create New Listener
createNew.description: Define a new Foundry listener in the project.

useExisting.label: Use Existing Listener
useExisting.description: Attach to a Foundry listener already declared in the project.

listenerConfig.label: Listener Configuration
listenerConfig.description: Configure the Foundry listener. The agent's project, name and version are read from the environment variables Foundry sets on the container.

existingListener.label: Listener
existingListener.description: Select an existing Foundry listener to attach the agent to.

metadata.label: Listener Name
metadata.description: Provide a name for the listener being created

metadata.label: Port
metadata.description: The port to listen on, or an existing http:Listener to share. Leave it empty to use the PORT environment variable, else 8088, which is what Foundry expects.

metadata.label: Foundry Hosted Agent
metadata.description: Handles Foundry invocations through fixed resources. The listener manages session and invocation IDs, platform headers and error responses, so the resources contain only agent logic.

metadata.label: Invoke
metadata.description: Handles POST /invocations: runs the agent for each request and returns its result.

metadata.label: Payload
metadata.description: The request body, bound to the type you declare, such as json or a record.

metadata.label: Foundry Context
metadata.description: The session and invocation IDs, user ID and other platform values of the invocation.

metadata.label: Readiness Probe
metadata.description: Handles GET /readiness, Foundry's readiness probe. Keep it cheap and never call the model here.

metadata.label: Get Invocation
metadata.description: Handles GET /invocations/{invocationId}: returns the status or result of an earlier invocation, such as one answered with 202 Accepted.

metadata.label: Foundry Context
metadata.description: The platform values of the request. Its invocation ID is the one in the path.

metadata.label: Cancel Invocation
metadata.description: Handles POST /invocations/{invocationId}/cancel: cancels an invocation that is still running.

metadata.label: Payload
metadata.description: The request body, if the caller sends one.

metadata.label: Foundry Context
metadata.description: The platform values of the request. Its invocation ID is the one in the path.
